<STRUCT_0001>
This notation is suggestive, and the things it suggests are true:
Given any morphism <MATH_0001> in <MATH_0002> and any two
morphisms <MATH_0003> and <MATH_0004> in <MATH_0005>, we have
<MATH_0006>.
Also, for any
<MATH_0007> and <MATH_0008> in <MATH_0009> and all
<MATH_0010> in <MATH_0011>, we have
<MATH_0012>.
Finally, for any <MATH_0013> in <MATH_0014>, all
<MATH_0015> in <MATH_0016>, and <MATH_0017> in <MATH_0018>, we have
<MATH_0019>.
This is all clear from the definition.
We can ``write any finite collection of morphisms with the same target
as fractions with common denominator''.
